abstract: Covers the JSON:API specification at v1.1 (finalized 2022-09-30): the application/vnd.api+json media type with its ext and profile parameters and 415/406 negotiation, document structure (data, errors, meta, links, included, jsonapi), resource objects with type, id and lid, relationships, resource linkage and compound documents with full linkage, fetching with include, sparse fieldsets, sorting, pagination and filtering, query parameter families and naming, creating, updating and deleting resources and relationships with their status codes, error objects, extensions, profiles, and the Atomic Operations extension. Version lines: 1.1 is current, 1.0 is supported, and the 1.2 working draft is tracked as a preview, with a 1.0 to 1.1 upgrade checklist. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out the version lines, document structure, fetching, writing, and content negotiation with errors and extensions.
